kubejs.ponder.blastfurnace.text_1: The blast furnace is a multiblock used to produce pig iron, which is vital in steelmaking
kubejs.ponder.blastfurnace.text_10: The blast furnace will drip molten pig iron into any liquid container directly below it
kubejs.ponder.blastfurnace.text_11: The crucible is the simplest method of collection
kubejs.ponder.blastfurnace.text_12: The molten pig iron will begin to cool inside the crucible, so you must remember to keep it hot
kubejs.ponder.blastfurnace.text_13: You can now cast your pig iron ingots and forge some refined steel!
kubejs.ponder.blastfurnace.text_2: The blast furnace must be constructed with insulated firebricks
kubejs.ponder.blastfurnace.text_3: Each layer can hold 4 iron-bearing items, 4 flux and 4 fuel
kubejs.ponder.blastfurnace.text_4: Up to a max of 5 layers and 20 items of each type
kubejs.ponder.blastfurnace.text_5: You must have equal parts of flux to iron
kubejs.ponder.blastfurnace.text_6: To insert items drop them down through the top of the blast furnace
kubejs.ponder.blastfurnace.text_7: If you use coke, you must use a bellows and tuyere
kubejs.ponder.blastfurnace.text_8: If you decide to use anthracite, then it's not required
kubejs.ponder.blastfurnace.text_9: Once the contents get hot enough, they will melt into molten pig iron inside the blast furnace
kubejs.ponder.bloomery.text_1: The bloomery is a multiblock used for producing iron blooms
kubejs.ponder.bloomery.text_2: The bloomery can have a minimum of 1 layer..
kubejs.ponder.bloomery.text_3: Up to a maximum of 3 layers!
kubejs.ponder.bloomery.text_4: The bloomery accepts 16 items per layer (8 charcoal and 8 Iron bearing items) up to a max of 48 items total
kubejs.ponder.bloomery.text_5: The Bloomery can be made out of almost any brick type
kubejs.ponder.bloomery.text_6: drop the required ratio of iron to charcoal into it (25 ore dust and 22 charcoal is recommended)
kubejs.ponder.bloomery.text_7: After some time, the bloomery will stop burning and you may now collect the blooms
kubejs.ponder.steam_engine.text_1: The Steam engine generates rotational power when steam is supplied
kubejs.ponder.steam_engine.text_2: To function, the engine must be connected to a flywheel and steam must be piped in
kubejs.ponder.steam_engine.text_3: To shut it off, input a redstone signal
